# MAD Viewer

> Fan-made, unofficial reference and viewer for the game Make Drama (MAD): live skin viewer, character profiles, story, events, stages, items and planning tools.

The game's images, text and other assets belong to their owners. The site's own code is AGPL-3.0.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://mad.altterisk.cc/): events, pickup banners and seasonal content running now
- [Viewer](https://mad.altterisk.cc/viewer/): play character skins and animations
- [Characters](https://mad.altterisk.cc/characters/): every character, with the game's filters
- [Story](https://mad.altterisk.cc/story/): story chapters and event scripts
- [Events and stages](https://mad.altterisk.cc/stages/): stages, enemies and drops
- [Items](https://mad.altterisk.cc/items/): items and materials

## Tools and references

- [Planner](https://mad.altterisk.cc/farm/): material needs for unit upgrades
- [Party](https://mad.altterisk.cc/party/): team building
- [Effects](https://mad.altterisk.cc/effects/): search skill effects
- [Formula](https://mad.altterisk.cc/formula/): how damage, healing and status chance are calculated
- [DPS comparison](https://mad.altterisk.cc/dps/): expected DPS and HPS on one target
- [Changelog](https://mad.altterisk.cc/changelog/): site updates

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://mad.altterisk.cc/sitemap.xml)
- [Source code](https://github.com/anyabot/MAD-Viewer)
